newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORINT ENDS STEADY VS BASKET, FIRMER VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: FORINT ENDS STEADY VS BASKET, FIRMER VS DLR.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket but firmer against the dollar in quiet Thursday trade, dealers said.
Against the dollar, it ended trading back under the 200-mark at 199.90/95, compared to 200.30/35 at midday and 200.60/70 at the opening.

The forint remained close to the central bank's resistance level throughout the day as it followed movements in the dollar/mark cross, and dealers saw no evidence of the pattern changing over the next few days.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
